Element counts are quoted twice in one reply with different values: the table gives 33,959 elements at 2.5 mm (9 mm plate) while the text says '9 mm 在 2.5 mm 已估計 57,279 元素'. The second number is the tool's pre-flight estimate, which is 1.6x the real count (see r2-2); the reader cannot tell.
The permanent-set guess ('永久彎曲應遠小於 0.1 mm') rests on the nominal leg moment and ignores the bend peak 29 % above yield. It is labelled 推測 and the tool limit is stated.

Stated the outer R12 assumption, 'yield 235 MPa from memory' when guessing S235 before he said it, and that welds, fatigue and plasticity are not modelled; reported tool results as tool results and its hand checks as 'my arithmetic'.
